title: Aurumix Gold Savings: Simulation Results
subtitle: What it takes for the business to be profitable, how much to raise, and what can be given back. Two thousand seven-year paths over two hundred thousand simulated customers.
tagline: Built by founders. Designed for founders.
legal: Prepared by Tokenomics.net for Aurumix. © 2026. Confidential.

intro: Aurumix works as a partner business. It does not work as a retail business. Customers who sign up directly do not, on their own, earn enough to pay the company's bills. Partners do. These figures are the plan exactly as written; Part 4 ranks every change that improves them and what each is worth.

Profit in year seven, typical run

findings.title: Partners are the business
findings.body: They bring 31% of year-seven revenue from a handful of contracts, and no partner has signed. Without them the seven years lose USD 4.29m and you would need USD 7.09m to survive. Across 2,000 runs with no partner, not one earned its money back.

findings.title: Only India makes money
findings.body: A customer costs USD 74 to win in the UAE and USD 13 in India. Every UAE and Gulf customer loses money. Each Indian customer leaves USD 14.92 a year, and India alone would cover all the company's fixed bills with 23,475 customers against the 48,240 the plan already reaches there.

findings.title: One direct customer barely pays for itself
findings.body: A direct customer brings in about USD 30 a year at steady state. Serving them, replacing the ones who leave and running the card cost about USD 27. About USD 2.39 is left. Covering the fixed bills that way needs 146,289 customers. The plan reaches 88,594. Or 2.5 partners cover the same bills.

findings.title: The plan has no room in it
findings.body: At today's cost per customer the plan needs 11 partners and plans for exactly 11. The typical run is still USD 0.45m short of repaying its early losses at month 84. If costs run 17% over, you need three more partners.
